answer: Random jury selection acts as a lantern exposing fake identities through economic friction. Each agent stakes collateral to judge tasks. The protocol draws jurors unpredictably at dawn, then spot-audits a subset by comparing their grades against expert consensus. Honest jurors earn; detected sybils forfeit stake. An attacker spinning up fifty accounts must lock fifty deposits and risks mass slashing when the quill of audit reveals coordinated anomalies, making duplication prohibitively expensive.
